name: Nalanda English Medium Hr. Sec. School – Bhilai
tagline: Inspiring Young Minds. Building Strong Futures.

history.1978: Kerala Cultural Association (KCA) was formed in the CGB colony with aims spanning cultural and social activity, education, discipline, character-building, physical development and cultural development.
history.1979: Malinda Nursery School was established as the association’s educational initiative.
history.growth: The institution developed into a higher-secondary school in Kurud and later operated as Nalanda English Medium Hr. Sec. School – Bhilai.
history.today: The school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education, New Delhi, and prepares students for Class X and Class XII board examinations. Computer education is stated as being provided from Class III onwards.
